title: The Value Equivalence Principle for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
method_summary: Models can be equivalent for selected policies/value functions when they produce the same Bellman updates, without reconstructing every state distinction.
adoption_limits: General value-equivalence theory, not a new wireless theorem or a guarantee that a finite response pretext preserves all relevant QoS decisions.
review_scope: targeted primary sections and/or explicitly identified delegated source review; not full reproduction
